observable_outcome: An owner registers a Repository through POST /v1/repositories and reads it back from GET /v1/repositories and GET /v1/repositories/{repository_id} and from /owner/: its identity, its source locator, and whether the loop can run against it with the measured reason. A Runner submits a read-only GitHub reachability Observation through POST /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:observe, produced by a gh CLI subprocess that holds no credential of its own, and the detail view reports executability from that Observation or reports it as unobserved. POST /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:retire returns the Installation to its pre-registration state without touching any other Repository. All four paths are declared in contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml. internal/domain/model.go and internal/domain/control.go are unchanged, no credential value exists in any record, document or log, and nothing is pushed to GitHub.
acceptance_criteria: A1. Fixed implementation order, with a mid-task stop. Implement in this order and do not begin a leg before the previous one compiles and its tests pass: (1) internal/domain/repository.go, (2) internal/application (ports.go member plus repository.go), (3) internal/store/memory, (4) internal/api plus contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml, (5) internal/store/firestore, (6) internal/web, (7) internal/runner/forge.go and its deterministic tests, (8) the live probe, (9) evidence. If legs 1 and 2 are not green before leg 4 begins, stop and escalate rather than carrying a broken seam forward. Report, per leg, the argv actually run and its verdict.

A2. Domain, one new file only. Add internal/domain/repository.go declaring: RepositoryID (opaque, via the existing opaqueID helper pattern), a SourceLocator value object with plain string fields Forge, Host, Owner, Name and DefaultBranch, RepositoryStatus with exactly the values "registered" and "retired", the Repository aggregate carrying ID, Locator, Status, Version and RequestedBy, a RepositoryCommand kind set, and standalone ValidateRepository and DecideRepository functions. Do NOT extend internal/domain/model.go's generic Validate or Decide type switches: follow the measured precedent that control.go, lease.go and release.go each keep their aggregate's functions outside that pair (Validate handles only *Requirement/*Increment/*Execution/*Lease and their value forms; Decide handles only Requirement and Increment; ControlIntent appears in neither). internal/domain/model.go, control.go, lease.go, release.go and id.go must be byte-identical at the end; report git diff --stat for internal/domain to prove it.

A3. No credential and no outward dependency in the domain. internal/domain/source_guard_test.go proves from the AST that no credential field and no GitHub, database, network or real-clock dependency exists in this package. It must keep passing unmodified with repository.go present. The SourceLocator carries no token, secret, password, auth or credential field under any spelling, and internal/domain/repository.go imports nothing outside the standard library subset the package already uses. Run the guard explicitly and record its verdict.

A4. Locator normalisation and the duplicate constraint, measured. Normalise the locator before comparison: lowercase host and owner and name, strip a trailing ".git", accept https and ssh and scp-style forms as the same repository, and reject a locator whose owner or name is empty or contains a path separator. Registering an already-registered normalised (forge, owner, name) triple must be refused with a 409-class conflict and must NOT create a second Repository. Assert at least these equivalences as a table: https://github.com/O/N, https://github.com/O/N.git, git@github.com:O/N.git and https://GitHub.com/o/n all normalise to one locator. Never store the raw URL as the identity or the key.

A5. Application, following the measured Capture pattern exactly. Add RegisterRepository, RetireRepository, ObserveRepository, ListRepositories and GetRepository to internal/application/repository.go, each mirroring Service.Capture (internal/application/service.go L581-651): callerActor role check, requestedBy for attribution, requireRequest on RequestID, requestFingerprint for idempotency, s.ids.Next for the identifier, s.mutate keyed by operation and request id, an Idempotency read that returns the prior response on a matching fingerprint and ErrIdempotencyConflict on a differing one, a domain.Permit gate on domain.PermitIntake with ControlTarget{InstallationID: s.config.InstallationID, RepositoryID: <the repository's own id>}, domain.Validate-equivalent validation via ValidateRepository, and an s.record event. Add exactly one member interface, RepositoryRepository, to internal/application/ports.go and include it in UnitOfWork; change no existing port method signature. Do not touch service.go, outbox.go or readmodels.go.

A6. Do not repair ServiceConfig.RepositoryID; record it. Measure and record in the application evidence that application.ServiceConfig.RepositoryID (internal/application/service.go L135) is consumed at L434, L734 and L1088 to build ControlTarget but is never set by cmd/control-plane/main.go L172, so ControlTarget.RepositoryID is the empty string on every production path and a domain.ScopeRepository Control Intent can never match (internal/domain/control.go L138). State it as debt owned by the successor stage-2 task (the coordinator assigns its id; V2-065..V2-070 are already taken by unrelated work). Do NOT change those call sites and do NOT add RepositoryID to the ServiceConfig construction in this task.

A7. The Repository is Installation-owned, never person-owned and never Runner-bound. The record carries RequestedBy for attribution only. Add no assignee, no owner-identity, no ACL, no permission field and no RunnerID field, and add no per-person filter to any view. Assert by test that a Repository registered by one owner subject is visible in the list to any authenticated owner caller, and that no Runner identifier appears anywhere in the persisted Repository record.

A8. Four routes, existing conventions, existing auth. In internal/api/repositories.go plus the dispatch in internal/api/api.go add: GET /v1/repositories (owner), POST /v1/repositories (owner), GET /v1/repositories/{repository_id} (owner), POST /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:retire (owner), POST /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:observe (runner role, gated the way /v1/runner/permits:check gates RoleRunner at api.go L251-256). Use the existing Authenticator/RoleOwner seam with no new authentication mechanism and no new header. Follow the existing {id}:verb dispatch already used by /v1/leases/{lease_id}:renew and /v1/executions/{execution_id}:start. Assert 401 without auth, 403 for the wrong role on every one of the five, 405 on the wrong method, 415/400 on a bad content type or body, and the standard Error envelope with correlation_id.

A9. OpenAPI. Add /v1/repositories, /v1/repositories/{repository_id}, /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:retire and /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:observe to contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml with operationIds, security (iapOwner for the four owner operations, runnerSession for :observe), request schemas with additionalProperties:false, and the shared Error responses -- matching the file's existing single-line-mapping style. The path keys must be literal top-level keys of the form '  /path:' so internal/contracts openAPIDeclaredPaths (release_contract_test.go L322-331) sees them. Do NOT edit contracts/release-contract/foundation-capabilities.json, and do not add these paths to any capability's owner_surfaces; record that observation for the coordinator instead.

A10. The six declared observables, or an explicit unobserved state -- never a fabricated one. cap-repository-registration's observable_result requires the owner to see, after registration: identity, the Application Preview/Stable state, the applied 大原則 and Repository-specific rules, the Requirement Backlog state, the available Runners and AI resources, and whether the loop can run and why. Render each field. Where no data source exists at this commit, the field must carry an explicit machine-readable unobserved or not-implemented state together with its reason, and the detail response must never emit a plausible-looking value for a thing that was not measured. Enumerate in the api evidence, field by field, which are measured and which are explicitly unobserved and why. If satisfying any of them appears to require inventing a value, stop and escalate.

A11. Registration does not mutate anything external. Assert that registering a Repository performs no write to GitHub, creates no branch, ref, PR or repository, and changes no existing Application, credential or external resource -- the declaration's '登録によって既存Application、認証情報、外部resourceは無断で変更されない'. In the local closure this is a positive assertion that the registration path invokes no external process at all: prove it by construction (the Control Plane holds no forge client) and record how you proved it, not by inspection.

A12. Retire is the rollback, and it is a transition. POST /v1/repositories/{repository_id}:retire moves registered -> retired through DecideRepository, is idempotent by request_id, refuses any other source status, excludes the Repository from the list view, and leaves every other Repository byte-identical. Assert with at least two registered Repositories that retiring one does not alter the other's stored record or version. Never delete the aggregate.

A13. The Control Plane never invokes gh or git. Assert mechanically, not by review, that no file under internal/api, internal/application, internal/domain, internal/store or cmd/control-plane constructs an exec.Command or otherwise spawns a process, and that none of them references gh or git. State the method (AST scan or equivalent) and give it a positive control: a deliberately planted matching pattern in a scratch input must be detected, and the before/after of that positive control is recorded. This is the structural form of decision d6 and of docs/policies/README.md L42.

A14. The forge adapter: gh subprocess, absolute path, credential as an absence. Add internal/runner/forge.go with a ForgeClient that shells out to the gh CLI to read repository existence, default branch and viewer push permission, and returns a bounded Observation value carrying no raw output. Requirements, each asserted deterministically without invoking gh: (a) the executable is resolved to an absolute path using the existing resolveTool pattern in internal/runner/confinement.go (PATH first, then /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin, /sbin), because it is measured that gh is NOT on the devbox run --pure PATH while git IS; (b) filepath.Base of the resolved path must equal "gh" or the call is refused before any process starts, mirroring V2-017 d6; (c) the child environment is the guarded base environment only -- granted_names is the empty array and the Secret Broker is not consulted, because gh reads its own store at ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml and takes no credential from argv or environment (V2-017 d8); (d) a non-empty granted set, a missing executable and a basename mismatch are each refused with a distinct error and each has a test; (e) no gh stdout or stderr is ever returned, journaled or logged verbatim -- only the parsed bounded fields.

A15. The live probe: read-only, gated, and never a skip counted as a pass. Add TestForgeReachabilityLive in internal/runner/forge_live_test.go, skipped unless AGENTIC_LOOP_LIVE_FORGE=1, and never reachable from make check. It performs a read-only reachability check against a real GitHub repository and asserts existence, default branch and viewer push permission. It must not create, modify or delete any branch, ref, tag, PR, issue or repository, and must not run gh auth setup-git or mutate any git config. Run it with devbox run --pure -e AGENTIC_LOOP_LIVE_FORGE=1 (the environment is stripped by --pure, so -e is required) and record: the resolved absolute gh path, the output of gh --version, the authenticated account login, the repository's owner/name, its node id and its default branch, uname -srm, go version and the devbox environment. If the probe cannot run because authentication has lapsed or api.github.com is unreachable, record the measured failure, mark the check status "skipped" with its reason, do NOT count it as a pass (gate rule G7), do NOT substitute a local, fake or emulated result (G3.1), and escalate.

A16. Push nothing, and create no probe branch. This task performs no GitHub write and no git commit outside the ordinary task commits. Do not create a throwaway or probe branch anywhere: docs/architecture/validation.md L187 records that gitleaks git scans every ref in the repository, so a left-behind probe branch keeps the gate red. Record, without acting on it, the measurement that no git credential.helper is configured at repository or global scope on this machine, so a bare git push over HTTPS could not authenticate, and that gh auth git-credential exists in gh 2.92.0 -- this is input for the successor stage-3 task, not work for this one.

A17. Both stores, in the same change. Implement RepositoryRepository in internal/store/memory/store.go (including the copy-on-write state clone at store.go L39-46 so a transaction rollback does not leak) and in internal/store/firestore/store.go, with optimistic concurrency on Version exactly as SaveRequirement does (internal/store/memory/store.go L236-245). The firestore leg runs under scripts/firestore-emulator.sh, which make check already invokes via component-store-firestore. Assert in both: a create at expected version 0, a conflicting concurrent save refused, and the duplicate-locator constraint. Do not add or change firestore.indexes.json; if an index is required, stop and escalate.

A18. Owner UI. Extend internal/web/owner.html, owner.js and owner.css with a Repository section that registers a Repository and lists the registered ones with their identity and executability state. Keep it server-rendered with no provider SDK, no external asset and no secret-bearing data path (internal/web/web.go's stated constraint). internal/web currently has no test file; add none unless it is deterministic and needs no browser. Do not change the existing capture or control forms' behaviour.

A19. Documentation, two narrow edits only. In docs/architecture/domain-model.md, within the '### Repository' subsection only, elaborate the '- source locatorとdefault branch' attribute into the implemented shape (forge, host, owner, name, default branch) and state the concurrency answer (optimistic concurrency version, as Requirement has at L59), because the document currently leaves both unspecified. In docs/operations/runner-local.md, record the measured forge-adapter facts alongside the existing V2-016/V2-017 runner-local measurements: gh absent from the devbox --pure PATH while git is present, absolute-path resolution with the basename assertion, and credential isolation proven as an absence with granted_names empty. Change no other document and no other section. Do not touch docs/preview/capabilities.md: cap-repository-registration is still not Preview-proven and its prose is still accurate.

A20. Existing tests. Every pre-existing test in internal/domain, internal/application, internal/store/memory, internal/store/firestore, internal/api, internal/web, internal/runner and internal/contracts still passes under its existing name with its assertions unchanged. Report the before and after top-level test counts per package.

A21. Determinism. No fixed sleep, no wall-clock timer and no goroutine in any new test. The observation staleness rule is evaluated against an injected clock; any waiting is bounded deadline polling. A measured duration is logged as an observation, never asserted as a threshold.

A22. Ownership and the component boundary. devbox run --pure -- make ownership must be green: every new file must fall under an existing ci/components.json component root. This is why the forge adapter lives in internal/runner and not in a new package. If any file you need cannot be placed under an existing root, stop and escalate; do not edit ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum or devbox.*.

A23. Evidence, nine records. Create .agents/v2/evidence/V2-064-<component>.json for each of domain, application, store-memory, store-firestore, api, web, contracts, runner and docs, with id ev-v2-064-<component>, task_id V2-064, correlation_id v2-064-repository-and-forge, and component set to that component id. Each records, for every check, the argv actually executed, the working directory, the timeout and a summary of the measured result. A skipped test is never counted as a pass (gate rule G7): record every skip with status "skipped" and its reason. Record the execution environment identifier (uname -srm, go version, devbox environment) in every record, and in the runner record additionally the real external system's identifiers per A15. Register all nine with exactly nine appended entries in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json whose evidence_hash values are the sha256 of each artifact's final committed bytes; touch no other task's entry. devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/contracts must be green with all nine in place (TestActiveEvidenceIndex requires a bijection between the index entries and .agents/v2/evidence/*.json).

A24. Evidence keys are read from the final green tree. Each record's evidence_key is its own component key read with devbox run --pure -- make evidence-keys on the final tree where make check is green, with every touched file already git-added: a new file not yet in the index is invisible to that key because the key's input set is derived from git ls-files. Record additionally, as a note without repairing it, that control-plane's evidence key also moves because contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml is one of its declared contract_dependencies while its roots are untouched, and that no task-ledger record is issued; both are resolved by V2-045 under gate rule G6.

A25. make check, twice, and the secret gate after the commit. devbox run --pure -- make check is green, and it is re-run after the evidence commit so the secret scan reads committed history rather than an uncommitted working tree (gitleaks git scans commits, not the working tree). Record both runs with their argv, working directory, timeout and verdict, and judge the outcome by the verdict line, not by the exit code of devbox run.

A26. No credential value, anywhere. No credential, token or secret value appears in any source file, test fixture, record, document, log or evidence summary, in any form including a redacted-looking placeholder that is a real value. No prompt and no raw provider or gh response is retained. The authenticated account login is an identity label, not a credential, and is the only account-related value that may be recorded.

A27. Do not weaken the contract. contracts/release-contract/foundation-capabilities.json is not edited. Do not narrow, reinterpret or annotate cap-repository-registration's or cap-autonomous-resolution's outcome_conditions, observable_result or external_dependencies to match what was built. Record explicitly in the api evidence that cap-autonomous-resolution is NOT closed by this task and cannot be, because its declaration requires Preview観測結果 and Stable反映状況 which depend on a Preview deploy that is external-unavailable, and because the code change, verification run and integration legs belong to the two successor stages named in dp-v2-064 d1.

A28. Nothing outside allowed_paths changes. ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum, devbox.*, contracts/schemas/**, contracts/release-contract/**, cmd/**, internal/domain/model.go and internal/domain/control.go are untouched. Report git status --short and git diff --stat for the final tree.

A29. Escalate instead of improvising. Stop and escalate to the tech_lead, without editing, if: a new CI component appears necessary; the gh reachability probe cannot run or returns 401/403; a firestore index would be required; satisfying A10 would require inventing a value; changing internal/domain/model.go, internal/domain/control.go or service.go's existing target construction appears necessary; the Firestore emulator cannot start; or the capability declaration appears to need editing. In every case record the measurement that led there and issue no evidence record claiming passed for the affected check.
